cohort: 150 women with a previous lower-segment Caesarean section and a short interconceptional period.
finding: Short interconceptional period is significantly associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, higher repeat Caesarean section rates, and increased maternal complications.
mod_finding: VBAC was achieved in 66.7% of women, with scar thickness >3.5 mm significantly associated with successful VBAC, and repeat CS accounted for 33.3% of births.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured to determine preterm delivery (before 37 weeks).
